test_title: PYST 205: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 29th Nov,, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

Your decision to stay home this weekend is __more better than mine__ to go out for dinner.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'much better than mine'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In this sentence, we need to substitute the underlined segment as it is erroneous her
